note: Every individual part of a chassis is destructible. The cockpit and torso sections have explicit destruction thresholds: >70% cockpit damage OR >90% aggregate torso-section damage triggers FULL DESTRUCTION and an automatic pilot emergency eject. Thresholds are configurable here and enforced identically in the browser prototype and the CET in-game pilot.

thresholds.note: Fractions of cumulative damage, not remaining integrity. > means strictly greater than.

sections.torso: Central hull, reactor, bus, capacitors, coolant, backpack, hips, shoulders
sections.system: ECM, vents, radiators, thrusters, jump jets
sections.weapon: Designed weapon mounts and shield emitters

eject.label: EMERGENCY EJECT
eject.note: Manual eject is always available; automatic eject fires the instant either destruction threshold is exceeded. (X is used; E remains VORTEX SHIELD in COMBAT / PILOT TEST.)

consequences.partDestroyed: that part stops contributing its mass / heat / signature to the render and its function is lost
consequences.cockpitCritical: canopy breach: HUD flicker, reduced sensor range, brownout risk
consequences.torsoCritical: reactor / bus exposure: forced vent, loss of power transfer, structural stress
consequences.destroyed: full destruction, pilot ejected, all spawned entities despawned, run ends

disclaimer: Damage is a simulation of engineering consequences over vanilla game records / procedural meshes. It does not edit game assets, add custom rigs or claim in-game verification.
